notes: v0.3.75: SAME-WIFI CONNECTION FIX (verified root cause). Same-network path now probes LAN then NAT-hairpin with a real handshake before committing, and falls back to relay if both are blocked (router AP/client isolation or firewall). Previously same-IP declared 'Connected' over a dead link with no fallback. Also: ASIO→WASAPI auto-fallback now uses SHARED mode, fixing 'connected but no audio' on the laptop.
